model.name: changeRequest.traceabilityChildPerCrApprove
model.description: CRs render as traceability children of the task (same shape as Requirement); each carries its own approval state; the owner approves EACH CR individually AT the task (owner-gated, his QA judgment); the band derives from any-CR-unapproved and clears only when every CR is individually approved; the bulk resolve action is retired. Architect wires Class/Method off the shipped decl on build-go (POST-Tron-review).
model.note: Architect designs mechanics + wires on build-go, AFTER Tron sees the shape. NO build until his approval.
